annotations.title: Heating and cooling degree days forecast

description: Heating and cooling degree days forecast — Forecast heating (HDD) and cooling (CDD) degree days for the next week at a US location from the NWS 7-day forecast: per-day high, low, mean, HDD and CDD vs a base temperature (default 65 F, base= 40-80), weekly totals and averages, energy outlook HEATING/COOLING/MIXED/MILD and peak day. lat= and lon= (or place=). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
